skill_name: Write a persuasive essay about why people should read books.
workflow: Reading books is an invaluable activity that offers numerous benefits to all readers, regardless of age or background. Reading books can increase knowledge, expand the imagination, foster empathy and understanding, stimulate the mind, improve focus and concentration, and reduce stress. Additionally, reading is an activity that can be done anywhere, anytime.
